implementation_notes: Treat the map as a tile map, not one flattened background image, so the player can walk through it and the camera can follow.
Use the generated map reference image as the visual layout target; use the atlases and extracted sprites as the actual drawing assets.
Build large buildings as foreground/decorative sprites with collision rectangles around walls; do not use the entire sprite rectangle as a solid collision area if it blocks walkways.
Keep roads and sidewalks passable. Add collision only to buildings, fences, water, rocks, trees and other obstacles.
Use nearest-neighbor scaling when resizing pixel-art sprites to keep edges crisp.
Some extracted crops contain multiple touching props as one grouped sprite; check the numbered index pages and use the original atlases for context.
